description: Get the link where a person books a free call with Agent Loopr, and what to have ready. It returns a link only: it never books, holds or changes a meeting. A person always picks the time themselves.

interest.description: What the person wants to talk about, if known. Only used to tag the link so we can see which service the call is about.

name: agentloopr_get_booking_link
title: Get the booking link
